content.subject: Quick thought on VersaPay's portfolio sale
content.draft_text:
Hi Sam,
VersaPay recently agreed to sell its merchant services portfolio, indicating M&A restructuring. That typically creates intercompany reconciliation sprawl, adding manual matching effort across entities, increasing audit risk, delaying financial close, and stretching finance team capacity during integration. We automate manual reconciliation workflows by linking transaction feeds to a unified ledger, generate audit‑ready reports, and reconcile discrepancies automatically. Worth a 15‑minute call next week?
